g.text: 1. Three-stage steam ejector set, each stage 2 x 50 % in parallel (J-20xA/B); MP motive steam.
2. Barometric legs from E-202/203/204 sealed in hotwell D-201 (min. 10.5 m leg height).
3. C-201 pressure control by off-gas recycle to J-201 (1st stage) suction via PV-2010; TSVs on CW sides.
4. Vacuum off-gas to H-201 burners via D-202 and PV-2031 (backpressure).
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
